{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Heard you broke the record doing the Sevari Sidestep. Got out with a cargo hold full of carsunum spice.|[[Bolabo Hujaan]], to Dash Rendar|<ref name="All the Extras">{{WEGCite|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook|story=All the Extras}}</ref>}}
The '''Sevari Sidestep''' was a maneuver used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to bypass the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sevarcos II]] when picking up [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] broke the record for the Sevari Sidestep with a cargo hold full of [[Carsunum/Legends|carsunum]].
